answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The anchor holds work receipts rather than names, so the tide of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
